name: io.github.Authoritt/aethra
title: Aethra
description: Self-hosted control plane whose MCP surface IS the control plane, not a wrapper over a REST API: 117 tools for git deploys with blue-green swaps, reverse proxy routes, automatic TLS over ACME, Cloudflare DNS and tunnels, uptime monitors, metrics and backups. NOT a standalone tool server: it requires its own Postgres to start, and the MCP endpoint requires a scoped API key.

environmentVariables.name: ConnectionStrings__Aethra
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string. REQUIRED — the reverse-proxy config provider loads its routes in its constructor, so without a reachable database the process does not reach a running state. This is deliberate: a proxy that boots with zero routes would serve nothing to every hostname it fronts.

environmentVariables.name: Identity__AdminPasswordSeed
environmentVariables.description: Password for the admin account seeded on first boot, when the users table is empty. Change it after logging in.

environmentVariables.name: DataProtection__KeyDir
environmentVariables.description: Directory for Data Protection keys, mount a volume at it. Without persistence, every encrypted secret becomes unreadable after a container restart.

environmentVariables.name: Aethra__ApplyMigrationsOnStart
environmentVariables.description: Run EF migrations at startup. Off by default outside Development on purpose: a managed deployment runs them from its pipeline, and two instances migrating at once is worse than neither.
